components.name: AgentActivity
components.doc: A live timeline of what an agent is doing. The step in progress pulses and collects what it finds as chips; a step that finishes leaves the live list and folds into one summary row that counts steps and time, which opens to show them again.

members.name: kind
members.doc: What kind of work the step is; it picks the icon.

members.name: title
members.doc: What the agent is doing, in a few words: "Searching the codebase".

members.name: detail
members.doc: One line of detail: the query, the file, the command.

members.name: items
members.doc: Short things the step found or touched (file names, sites, results). They appear as chips, one by one as the list grows.

members.name: duration
members.doc: How long the step took, in milliseconds. Shown once it has finished.

members.name: steps
members.doc: The steps in order. Update their status as the agent works.

members.name: title
members.doc: Heading of the timeline: usually the task the agent was given.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: Whether the finished steps are shown in full (controlled).

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.doc: Whether the finished steps start shown in full (uncontrolled). By default they fold into one summary row.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called when the summary row opens or closes the finished steps.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.
